column8: a giant looming silhouette of a man in a plain black fedora with a black hatband, wearing a single red scarf, towering over a small ordinary man walking below who does not notice him, flat cream sky

a rain-slicked Paris street at night seen from a low angle, tall haussmannian facades as flat black silhouettes, two or three windows glowing pale cream, a black vintage car parked along the curb with dark unlit tail-lights, one single lit street lantern glowing red, every other street lamp dark and unlit, its reflection in the wet pavement

a man in his thirties in a plain black t-shirt, bust portrait in three-quarter view, short undercut hair with a dark textured top, a full dark moustache and short beard, a single pair of black leather aviator goggles pushed up on his head, only one pair of goggles, a small dark stud earring, black wire-framed round sunglasses whose mirrored lenses are the single blood-red element, hiding his eyes completely, impassive expression, plain background

a factory built from typewriter parts, its chimneys are black typewriter hammers, black iron gantries and pipes, a conveyor belt of blank pale cream pages leaving the building, seen from ground level, a single red inked ribbon threading through the whole factory like a vein, all other machine parts in black iron, plain background
